title: TRACER: Token ReAssignment for Concept ERasure in Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2606.07688v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative recommendation formulates next-item prediction as autoregressive generation over semantic ID (SID) sequences derived from users' historical interactions, making modern recommender systems structurally similar to large language models (LLMs). As privacy and safety concerns grow, these systems increasingly require concept unlearning to remove sensitive or harmful concepts associated with items. However, existing LLM unlearning methods cannot be directly applied to generative recommendation. Unlike word tokens with explicit semantics, SIDs are abstract identifiers that are often shared by both forget and retain items, leading to severe conflicts between concept removal and recommendation utility preservation.   To address this challenge, we propose TRACER, an end-to-end concept unlearning framework based on token reassignment. translated_title: TRACER：用于生成式推荐中概念擦除的标记重新分配方法
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐将下一项预测表述为对源自用户历史交互的语义ID（SID）序列的自回归生成，这使得现代推荐系统在结构上与大语言模型（LLM）相似。随着隐私和安全问题的日益凸显，这些系统越来越需要概念遗忘技术来移除与物品相关的敏感或有害概念。然而，现有的LLM遗忘方法无法直接应用于生成式推荐。与具有明确语义的词元不同，SID是抽象标识符，通常同时被需要遗忘的物品和需要保留的物品所共享，这导致概念移除与推荐效用保持之间存在严重的冲突。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了TRACER，一个基于标记重新分配的端到端概念遗忘框架。TRACER并非直接抑制共享的SID，而是将概念相关的物品重新分配到替代的……
tldr: 提出TRACER端到端概念遗忘框架，通过将概念相关物品重新分配到替代标记而非直接抑制共享SID，解决了生成式推荐中概念擦除与推荐效用保持之间的冲突。
en_tdlr: TRACER is an end-to-end concept unlearning framework for generative recommendation that resolves the conflict between concept erasure and utility preservation by reassigning concept-related items to alternative tokens instead of directly suppressing shared SIDs.
